---
name: Bug report
about: Something verified when it shouldn't, or failed when it shouldn't
labels: bug
---
**What happened** — the behavior, plainly.

**Reproduction** — the exact commands. If it can't be replayed, say so plainly: an unrepeatable metric is a bug.

**Expected** — what the journal/verifier/guardrail should have said.

**Environment** — version (`noirebox --version`), Python, OS.

**Journal evidence** — an export that reproduces (strip personal payloads), if relevant.
